headline: Houthis claim attacks on Saudi Arabia's East-West oil pipeline
summary: Iran-backed Houthi forces claimed attacks on pumping stations along Saudi Arabia's East-West crude oil pipeline and the Riyadh airport.
why: Saudi Arabia is a primary global crude exporter, and its infrastructure security directly impacts international oil supply stability and geopolitical risk premiums.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Security threats to major crude export pipelines in the Middle East heighten supply disruption fears, driving up oil prices.

why_moved: Geopolitical strikes on critical energy transport infrastructure raise concerns over potential petroleum supply disruptions.
